content: He who returns good for evil is like the sandalwood tree that perfumes the axe that wounds it.
author: Chinese Proverbs
explanation: When an axe strikes ordinary wood, chips fly in fury. But when it strikes fragrant sandalwood, the fragrant resin clings to the iron blade, returning fragrance for injury. To repay cruelty with forgiveness is not weakness; it is the ultimate alchemy of the spirit.
practicalInsight: If someone is harsh or rude to you today, respond with genuine gentleness. Leave the fragrance of grace on their rough blade.
reflectionPrompt: Who has wounded you recently, and what would it look like to perfume their blade with quiet forgiveness?
